label.purpose: Table headers, status pills and compact metadata.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Snackbar and the detail-page bookmark actions popup only (the only legal overlay shadow value).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion override for transitions and animations.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Wrap toolbars and stack selected task, history, settings and Pixiv browser controls.

density.name: control-density
density.purpose: Material Web outlined text fields and selects unified via size-token overrides only (main.css control-density layer: top/bottom space 8px, input text 14px, line height 24px); buttons keep Material defaults; component appearance untouched.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Material Web primary action such as start, save, resume or confirm.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Material Web secondary action such as browse, sync or batch delete.

components.name: Form Controls
components.description: Material Web controls for source IDs, settings and selection, unified to 40px height and 14px input text by control-density size tokens (main.css); appearance untouched. The settings form adds two groups on the existing form/fieldset structure at the same 40px density with no new tokens: Image quality (list-grid / detail / fullscreen thumbnail tiers, defaults medium / medium / large) and Content (the R-18 toggle, default true).

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Flat 256px left navigation that collapses to 72px via the header-row toggle button: browse section on top, one divider, then a single Tools item (/tools* prefix active); no group headings, nav scrolls when the window is short. Active item uses primary-container; footer is an avatar chip (avatar + account name + up caret, 8% primary hover) that opens the account menu.

components.name: Account Menu
components.description: Light popover anchored above the sidebar avatar chip: width 264px, surface-container background, 12px radius, the established soft shadow 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%), no dark scrim (a transparent layer only catches click-outside, Escape closes too); holds the account list (current one checked, click to switch), add-account, a divider, the Settings entry (icon + label + trailing caret) and logout (danger label, disabled when logged out). 40px menu rows with 8% primary hover; 0.15s ease pop from the bottom-left origin (reduced-motion covered globally); sits below the snackbar z-order.

components.name: Settings Dialog
components.description: Modal native dialog opened by the account menu's Settings entry (the menu closes first, one overlay at a time): width min(600px, 92vw), max-height min(84vh, 100%), surface-container background with the shared 28px radius and scrim; header row (title + close button) above a scrolling body hosting the SettingsPanel form (fields grouped as form/fieldset sections so new groups slot in). Closes on Escape, backdrop click or the header close button, restoring an unsaved theme preview first; sits below the snackbar z-order.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Native dialog recipe kept in one place (main.css dialog layer): surface-container, 28px radius, 24px padding, 35% scrim, 18px/700 headline; supporting text right after the headline uses on-surface-variant, and .dialog-actions right-aligns the button row with a 24px top gap. Material Web's dialog component is not used.

components.name: Task Progress
components.description: Material Web linear progress paired with text-first status and metadata.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Global top-right notification that disappears after 3.2 seconds.

components.name: App Pagination
components.description: Cross-domain pager in components/common covering total echo, page-size select, prev/next, a page window with ellipsis, a quick-jump input group (aligned with antd showQuickJumper) and compact responsive collapse; a controlled stateless component emitting update:currentPage / update:pageSize / change (v-model friendly; resetting to page 1 after a size switch stays with the parent). Pass total or totalPages (one of the two; totalPages wins) for a known pageCount, or neither for the unknown-total simple mode: no page window, a constant 'Page N' label and next gated by hasNext (default true). Default look is a four-segment row: the '{count} items' total line on the left (14px/500 on-surface-variant, overridable by the #start slot for ranking rank ranges), prev/next plus the page window in the middle, the quick-jump input group at the row end (margin-left auto), and the size select rightmost (hugging the jump group's right; the two form the row-end pair). All row controls share a uniform 32px control height (expressed as --space-lg * 2, vertically centered by the row's flex layout; the sub-640px compact state follows the same rule). The size dropdown renders only when pageSizeOptions is given, as a small native select ({n} / page options, 32px tall, 13px text, surface-container background, 45% outline border, radius-control corner, same recipe as the reader jump select); the quick-jump input group renders only in the default variant with a known pageCount > 1 (hidden for a single page and in the unknown-total mode) as a label of three inline parts — 'Go to' + an input[type=text][inputmode=numeric] + 'Page'; the input is 48px wide (--space-xl * 2), 32px tall, 13px centered text, surface-container background, 45% outline border, radius-control corner (same recipe as the size select), with a focus-visible 2px primary ring (2px offset); on Enter or blur the input is parsed — an integer landing inside 1..pageCount navigates through the existing update:currentPage + change chain and clears the field, out-of-range or non-numeric input only clears the field without navigating; when the whole component is disabled the input is disabled too and the group's labels fall back to the outline role; prev/next are self-drawn 32px pill icon buttons with 20px chevrons (stroke 1.8, 8% primary hover state layer, never text glyphs); page numbers are 32px self-drawn pill buttons (999px radius, 14px/500) with the current one in secondary-container / on-secondary-container marked aria-current=page, unselected hover as an 8% primary state layer and disabled text falling back to the outline role; the window shows every page at pageCount <= 7, otherwise first/last plus a current±2 window and a plain-text ellipsis (the ellipsis itself is not clickable). Under 640px (compact) the window collapses to '{current} / {total}' (unknown mode keeps 'Page N') while prev/next, the quick-jump group and the size select remain (wrapping naturally via flex-wrap). variant=reader reuses the novel-reader sticky recipe (surface background, top divider, prev/next icon buttons + 'Page X / Y' jump select) without the window or total area. Transitions stay at 0.15s ease, no shadow, and custom controls carry a focus-visible 2px primary ring (2px offset).

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Browse artwork card: 12px rounded cover, two-line title, pill badges for page count and R-18 (ink/surface), hover 8% primary state layer, no shadow. Whole card is clickable; cover-corner quick actions (see Card Quick Actions) render on browse channel cards only.

components.name: Card Quick Actions
components.description: Cover-corner quick actions on browse channel cards: 28px pill icon buttons in surface-container/ink, revealed on hover or focus-within, 8%/12% primary state layers, reduced-motion aware; buttons sit outside the role=button card and carry aria-label + title. Bookmark page cards may render the same-spec Remove-bookmark heart action (only when the item carries a bookmarkId).

components.name: Work Grid
components.description: auto-fill minmax(160px,1fr) grid with static skeleton blocks (no shimmer), empty/error/retry states and no-more footer.

components.name: Viewer Stage
components.description: Full-page artwork viewer stage on neutral near-black rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78). Multi-page works read as a vertical scroll stage: pages stack top to bottom and load only near the viewport (static placeholder blocks reserved to the page aspect ratio, 2:3 fallback, low-res layer before the detail tier, so loading never shifts the layout); single-page works and the masked state center the artwork vertically in the stage instead of stacking. Clicking any page opens the fullscreen overlay; a sticky top-right fullscreen button is the keyboard entry (opens at the page in view) and a bottom-right 'N / M' badge (12px/600 white on the near-black) follows scrolling; the stage is focusable and scrolls natively (focus returns to it when the overlay closes), smooth scrolling disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. The R-18 blur(24px) mask with its confirm button is remembered per session and only appears while the show_r18 setting is off (deep-link fallback); with show_r18 on (default) the detail page shows no confirmation overlay. While masked only the first page is loaded, blurred, and the overlay cannot be bypassed.

components.name: Novel Reader
components.description: 720px column, 14px/1.8 body, chapter headings 16px/700, sticky pager with page select; the top bar carries back / title / author / bookmark / comments / fill-form / open-in-browser (see Detail Topbar Actions) and the column ends in the switchable related-works / comments panel (see Detail Panel).

components.name: Series Episode Page
components.description: Series episode page at /browse/series/:kind(novel|illust)/:id (legacy /browse/series/:id functionally redirects to the novel segment; watchlist 'manga' is watchlist semantics mapped to 'illust' at entry points), shared by novel and illustration/manga series. Header: 120px square cover (12px radius; an empty illust series cover falls back to the first episode cover) + single-line ellipsis title (wraps under 640px) + author link + HTML-stripped caption + an 'N episodes - status' stat line (12px/600 on-surface-variant; the illust endpoint has no completion flag so it always reads Ongoing) + action row (novel: fill form + open on pixiv; illustration/manga: open on pixiv only). Below it a toolbar: a 'Series contents' label (12px/600 on-surface-variant) on the left and two 30px hand-drawn SVG icon toggles (grid_view / view_list, stroke 1.8) on the right; selected = secondary-container / on-secondary-container, unselected = transparent + ink with 8% on-surface hover, aria-pressed + aria-label, focus-visible 2px primary ring; mode is remembered per session, defaulting to grid for illust and list for novel. Grid repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px,1fr)) (same as WorkGrid): illust cover cards = 1:1 cover + a top-left #N pill (999px, 12px/600, surface-container/ink, same recipe as the work-card page-count badge) + a top-right R-18 badge (ink background, surface text) + a two-line clamped title with a page-count/date subline; novel tile cards = surface-container background, a 20px/600 #N, two-line title and word-count meta, 8% primary hover. List = 48px+ rows (surface-container rounded container, hairline dividers, 8% primary hover; illust rows add a 48px thumbnail and #N, novel rows keep the zero-padded order/title/right-aligned meta; under 640px the title wraps and meta drops to its own line). Pager reuses the novel-reader recipe (sticky bottom, prev/next + page select, disabled at bounds): novel 30 per page (last_order=(page-1)*30), illust 12 per page (native page-based endpoint); page switches keep old content with a local opacity transition (no flicker) and first paint uses static skeleton blocks. The global R-18 filter applies to episode entries only (same in grid and list), never to the header. Entry points: watchlist cards, work/novel detail series navigation and search ID direct-jump (novel/series/{id} → novel segment, user/{uid}/series/{sid} → illust segment) all land here.

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Channel section headings are 16px/600 on-surface-variant; tag-recommendation blocks (illustration channel only, placed between Daily Ranking and Latest Posts) emphasize the #TagName in on-surface with a muted 'recommended illustrations' suffix, show up to 12 cards each, and join the shared R-18 render-time filter (a fully filtered-out block disappears as a whole and feeds the hidden count). Kind/period switches use secondary md-tabs; the Tools page reuses the same secondary tabs (SectionTabs wrapper) as its sub-route navigator; top-three ranking badges use primary-container.

components.name: Login Guard
components.description: Browse commands on a logged-out session return a fixed message and open the existing login dialog; browse views never re-implement login UI.

components.name: Browse Home Header
components.description: Browse home title row with the shuffle action vertically centered; auxiliary refresh actions stay at text-button level (md-text-button with an 18px stroke refresh icon), never outlined or filled.

components.name: Bookmark Page
components.description: Own-bookmarks page: type secondary tabs plus a public/private pill segmented toggle (surface-container track, primary-container selected); left sticky 180px tag rail (All row with summed count, tag rows with 12px/600 count badges, empty name shown as Untagged, wrapping to chips under 640px); right side total line + WorkGrid with hover Remove-bookmark action. Other users' public bookmarks (author tab) stay rest=show without the remove action.

components.name: Bookmark Button
components.description: Detail topbar bookmark trigger aligned to the outlined-button spec (40px pill, 18px heart): outline heart + Bookmark when empty, filled heart + Bookmarked with a Private badge when restrict=1; opens a native details popup (surface-container, 12px radius, the single legal overlay shadow) offering public/private add or remove; disabled with aria-busy while in flight, closes on outside pointerdown or Escape.

components.name: Detail Topbar Actions
components.description: Shared action row of the artwork viewer and the novel reader top bars: labeled actions stay at the 40px outlined pill (bookmark, see Bookmark Button), while icon actions use md-icon-button (40x40, no outline, on-surface-variant icon, selected state via Material's toggle/selected) with a uniform 20px stroke-1.8 inline SVG, ordered bookmark / comments / fill-form / open-in-browser. An icon-only md-outlined-button is not allowed here - its 24px inline padding stretches a single icon into a ~66px wide pill - and a text glyph (chevron, cross) never stands in for an icon; browse pagers and the ranking date switcher follow the same md-icon-button + 20px chevron recipe, with md-text-button kept for labeled low-emphasis actions.

components.name: Detail Panel
components.description: Switchable lower panel shared by the viewer's right 320px info column and the novel reader's column: related works by default, comments once the topbar comment button is on (an md-icon-button toggle with selected state - filled bubble in primary - whose label flips between Show comments and Back to recommendations). Comments mount only when the panel is switched on, so their first page is fetched on open; roots then grow through load-more pagination and replies page in after expansion. Switching scrolls the panel into view (novel: block start with a 72px sticky-topbar margin; viewer: block nearest), and changing work (kind/id) resets the panel to related works.

components.name: R18 Quick Filter
components.description: Channel-page top row: a Content filter label with three pill options (All / General / R-18); the pills use the same recipe as the discover page filter chips (transparent background, 1px outline at 60%, --ink text, 13px/600; selected = secondary-container / on-secondary-container with transparent border, hover = 8% on-surface state layer), the existing 4-12px spacing, no new tokens. Selection is expressed with aria-pressed, keyboard reachable, focus-visible primary 2px ring. Defaults to the global show_r18 setting; a manual choice covers only the current channel page (illustration / manga / novel keep independent states and never leak into each other) and never rewrites settings. Filtered works are hidden at render time only (no refetch); the hidden count reuses the auxiliary-line level (12px, --ink-subtle = outline role), never a heading level or a card badge; an all-filtered page does not change the server paging decision.

components.name: Fullscreen Viewer
components.description: Fullscreen overlay opened from the viewer stage: reuses the same neutral near-black rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78) backdrop as part of that single exception, defines no separate visual, and must not spread to ordinary content containers. Each page box is sized as min(available width, (viewport height - overlay padding) x page aspect ratio), so portrait pages fill the height and landscape pages fill the width, and small images are scaled up to that box instead of being capped at their pixel size; one page per screen, or two side by side (8px gap) in spread mode. The bottom control bar (prev/next, page range, two-page-spread toggle, reading-direction toggle) and the top-right close button are hidden by default (opacity 0, pointer-events none) and fade in over 0.15s when the pointer enters the bottom strip or top-right hot zone or when they receive keyboard focus; they stay visible on hover-less (touch) devices and the transition is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Spread mode pairs pages 1-2 / 3-4 (clicking any filmstrip thumbnail lands on its pair), advances two pages at a time, shows a page range, highlights the whole pair in the filmstrip, and can read right-to-left (default) or left-to-right - right-to-left mirrors the paging group so the forward button moves to the left with its chevron flipped to point left and ArrowLeft advances, while the spread and direction toggles are not directional controls and never mirror; both preferences are remembered per session only. Escape or a click outside the image closes. The right side is a filmstrip rail fixed at 80px (64px square thumbnails at the grid tier, 12px radius, 8px gaps, self-scrolling with a 6px always-visible scrollbar that never auto-hides, never scrolling horizontally - thumbnails shrink to the remaining rail width once the scrollbar appears, staying square - kept on narrow windows) where the on-screen pages carry a white 2px ring and the primary page carries aria-current, a click jumps straight to that page, and the active thumbnail auto-scrolls into view while paging; the filmstrip only appears for multi-page works.

components.name: Watchlist Page
components.description: Series watchlist mirroring the official /following/watchlist: a Type label row with manga/novel secondary tabs; row series cards in a repeat(auto-fill, minmax(360px,1fr)) grid holding a 2:3 112px cover (12px radius), a 'Series' 12px overline, a 16px/600 two-line title, a 20px round-avatar author row and 'N episodes - date' 12px meta. Filled 'Read latest' (34px) is the primary action shared with the whole-card click (disabled when no latest work); the actions row is a sibling of the clickable area, indented to the info column (no indent under 640px). Both card kinds add a 'Series contents' entry into the in-app series episode page (novel cards → the novel segment; manga cards are watchlist semantics mapped to the illust segment). 8% primary hover, no shadow, no new motion; subscriptions are user-curated so no R-18 render-time filter applies; static surface-container skeleton blocks and centered empty/error states with retry.

narrative.overview: A compact desktop tool that uses Material 3 color roles and Material Web controls for Pixiv capture tasks.

rules.name: The Material Role Rule
rules.body: Use existing M3 color roles rather than a second color system.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Primary never means success, failure or warning; error, warning, progress and task states always pair a readable label with the color.

rules.name: The Truncation Rule
rules.body: History table titles and authors ellipsize and keep a title attribute; other long text must not shrink in font size to buy space.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows identify menus and snackbar overlays, not routine cards.

rules.name: The Compact Task Rule
rules.body: Alignment, whitespace and wrapping serve scannability of tasks, history and settings rather than manufacturing large empty areas.

rules.name: The Native-First Rule
rules.body: Reuse Material Web and native semantics before adding local component styles.

dos: Use Material Web controls and M3 color roles.
Keep task state textual as well as colored.
Preserve the 640px responsive rules and reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't restore Naive UI or the prior blue-white design language.
Don't add shadows to ordinary cards.
Don't use primary as a success, warning or error color.
